description: Once human and now something apart, fetchlings display the Shadow Plane’s ancient influence through monochrome complexions, glowing eyes, and the casting of supernatural shadows.

features.name: Shadow Magic
features.tldr: You wield innate magic linked to the Shadow Plane, letting you manipulate darkness.

features.name: Ancestry Heritage
features.tldr: Choose a fetchling heritage reflecting your unique connection to the plane of shadow.
